title: OCG Execution Receipt predicate body, v0.2
description: JSON Schema for the predicate body of an in-toto Statement v1 whose predicateType is https://ainumbers.co/attestations/ocg-execution-receipt/v0.2. Apply this schema to the Statement's predicate member. Additive over v0.1: every v0.1 predicate body is valid under this schema. Members unknown to this schema are allowed and passed through unvalidated; the members this version mints (controlRefs, anchors, sourceAnchor, tickmark) are strictly shaped.

controlRefs.description: GRC-consumer bindings: which control ids in which framework this receipt is cited against. id carries the control identifier only, never a control title or control text (AICPA and ISO copyright).

anchors.description: Independent transparency-log or anchoring-service pointers for this receipt, in addition to the v0.1 anchorBindings passthrough.

sourceAnchor.description: Where the human-source evidence for this receipt lives: a document digest plus a locator into it (a page or region reference, or a spreadsheet cell in sheet!cell form).

tickmark.description: The audit workpaper action a human reviewer recorded against this receipt. An annotation about a person's procedure, never evidence on its own that a control passed.
